articles.title: Letter: the Millrace Youth Center Did a Good Job This Winter
body: To the editor: Please keep the stormwater drain repair in the budget. Many of us on Dover Place use it every week. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.

articles.title: Council Delays Vote on Eaton Road Summer Concert Series
articles.deck: Supporters and opponents on Eaton Road disagreed about cost and timing.
body: Residents of Eastgate said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street. The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first.

Councilmember Isaac Marchetti asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $3,400. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.
Public works estimates the work will take about 28 weeks once it starts in February.
